#Function to change longitude
transform_longitude_vector <- function(lons) {
  sapply(lons, function(lon) ifelse(lon < 0, lon + 360, lon))
}

Run KBA for all PB Cluster 2 females identified without considering the seasons

PBC2Females <- read_csv("../results/PB_Cluster2.csv")
## New names:
## Rows: 48 Columns: 29
## ── Column specification
## ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── Delimiter: "," chr
## (5): Trip, Sex, clusterAll, cluster, IntCluster dbl (24): ...1, TOPPID,
## ProcedureYear, d13C, d15N, MaxLat_degrees, MinLon_de...
## ℹ Use `spec()` to retrieve the full column specification for this data. ℹ
## Specify the column types or set `show_col_types = FALSE` to quiet this message.
## • `` -> `...1`
col2keep <- c('TOPPID','IntCluster')
PBC2Females <- PBC2Females[,col2keep]

# Load the tracking data
data <- read.csv("../data/NESETracks6h.csv")
data$longitude <- transform_longitude_vector(data$longitude) # Shift to 0 - 360
range(data$longitude)
## [1] 172.2114 255.1674
#data$longitude <- data$longitude - 256 # ShiftLong  to avoid issues with the IDL
c2 <- c("FieldID","track_id","JulDate","longitude","latitude","Season","date_gmt", "time_gmt" )
data <- data[,c2]
colnames(data) <- c("FieldID","TOPPID","JulDate","longitude","latitude","Season","date_gmt", "time_gmt" )

# Match the clusters to the tracks
data <- data %>% semi_join(PBC2Females, by = 'TOPPID')

First step of the analysis

### FIRST STEP, RUN THE ANALYSIS FOR THE WHOLE POPULATION
# Prepare the data for analysis
NESE.data <- formatFields(
  dataGroup = data, 
  fieldID   = "TOPPID", 
  fieldDate = "date_gmt", 
  fieldTime = "time_gmt",
  fieldLon  = "longitude", 
  fieldLat  = "latitude"
)
## No format supplied for Date and Time fields, a default format ('ymd_HMS')
##       attempted when combining the fields. If error produced, see help page
##       ('?lubridate::parse_date_time') for information on date formats.
# Identify Año Nuevo as a colony
colony <- NESE.data %>% 
  summarise(
    Longitude = first(Longitude), 
    Latitude  = first(Latitude)
  )

# Identify the individual trips
NESE.trips <- tripSplit(
  dataGroup  = NESE.data,
  colony     = colony,
  innerBuff  = 100,      # kilometers
  returnBuff = 100,
  duration   = 100,      # hours
  rmNonTrip  = TRUE
)
## track 20100182 does not return to the colony
## track 20110181 does not return to the colony
## track 20120112 does not return to the colony
## track 20140171 does not return to the colony
# Creates the maps with the trips
pdf("../maps/NESEt2kba_Trips_PBC2.pdf")
mapTrips(trips = NESE.trips, colony = colony)
## Too many individuals to plot. Only 25 IDs will be shown.
## Trips colored by completeness. Indicate colorBy=='trip' to color by
##     trips.
dev.off()
## png 
##   2
mapTrips(trips = NESE.trips, colony = colony)

Kernel analysis

#NESE.trips$Longitude <- transform_longitude_vector(NESE.trips$Longitude)
NESE.tracks <- projectTracks(dataGroup = NESE.trips, projType = 'azim', custom=TRUE )
## Warning in .pointsToMatrix(x, poly = TRUE): longitude > 180
## Warning in .pointsToMatrix(p): longitude > 180
## NOTE: projection is data specific
# Estimate the scale, h value
NESE.hVals <- findScale(
  tracks   = NESE.tracks,
  scaleARS = TRUE,
  sumTrips = NESE.sumTrips)
## Warning: There were 56371 warnings in `mutate()`.
## The first warning was:
## ℹ In argument: `Dist = purrr::map2_dbl(.data$coords, .data$prev_coords,
##   poss_dist)`.
## ℹ In group 1: `ID = "2009003"` and `tripID = "2009003_01"`.
## Caused by warning in `.pointsToMatrix()`:
## ! longitude > 180
## ℹ Run `dplyr::last_dplyr_warnings()` to see the 56370 remaining warnings.
## No 'res' was specified. Movement scale in the data was compared
##         to a 500-cell grid with cell size of 5.409 km squared.
## No peak found for ID(s):2009009 2012017 2012020

NESE.hVals
##   med_max_dist step_length  mag   href scaleARS
## 1      1963.89        15.1 7.58 162.29        3
# Remove locations within 100 km of the colony
NESE.tracks <- NESE.tracks[NESE.tracks$ColDist > 100, ] # remove trip start and end points near colony

 # Kernel Density Estimates
NESE.KDE <- estSpaceUse(
  tracks = NESE.tracks, 
  scale = NESE.hVals$href, 
  levelUD = 50, 
  polyOut = TRUE 
  )
## No grid resolution ('res') was specified, or the specified resolution was
##     >99 km and therefore ignored. Space use was calculated on a 500-cell grid,
##     with cells of 6.707 square km
kde.fig <- mapKDE(KDE = NESE.KDE$UDPolygons, colony = colony)

print(kde.fig)

ggsave(filename = "../figures/kdeUB_PBC2.pdf",
       plot = kde.fig,
       device = cairo_pdf)
## Saving 7 x 5 in image
# Save the individuals UDs
st_write(NESE.KDE$UDPolygons, "../results/NESEUD50_PBC2_href.shp",append=FALSE)
## Deleting layer `NESEUD50_PBC2_href' using driver `ESRI Shapefile'
## Writing layer `NESEUD50_PBC2_href' to data source 
##   `../results/NESEUD50_PBC2_href.shp' using driver `ESRI Shapefile'
## Writing 47 features with 2 fields and geometry type Multi Polygon.

UD analysis

#tic()
NESE.repr <- repAssess(
  tracks    = NESE.tracks, 
  KDE       = NESE.KDE$KDE.Surface, 
  levelUD   = 50,
  iteration = 500)
## nls (non linear regression) successful, asymptote estimated for
##     bootstrap sample.

## Estimated asymptote differs from target; be aware that
##   representativeness value is based on estimated asymptote (i.e. est_asym).
#toc()

NESE.Site.1 <- findSite(
  KDE = NESE.KDE$KDE.Surface,
  represent = NESE.repr$out,
  levelUD = 50,
  popSize = 1800,     # 1800 individual adult females elephant seals at Año Nuevo
  polyOut =  TRUE
)

NESE.Site.2 <- findSite(
  KDE = NESE.KDE$KDE.Surface,
  represent = NESE.repr$out,
  levelUD = 50,
  popSize = 1800     # 1800 individual adult females elephant seals at Año Nuevo
  )


#Sitemap <- mapSite(NESE.Site.1, colony = colony)

mapSite(NESE.Site.2, colony = colony)

t2kba.1[t2kba.1 == 0] <- NA

t2kba.2 <- raster(NESE.Site.2, layer = 2, values = TRUE)
t2kba.2[t2kba.2 == 0] <- NA

#Save the data frame
saveRDS(NESE.Site.2,'../results/NESEt2kba_PBC2.rds')
writeRaster(t2kba.1,'../results/t2kba1_PBC2.tif',overwrite=TRUE)
writeRaster(t2kba.2,'../results/t2kba2_PBC2.tif',overwrite=TRUE)

Create the maps

library(stars)
## Loading required package: abind
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)


#Load the raster created originally
t2kba.i <- read_stars('../results/t2kba1_PBC2.tif')
t2kba.i[t2kba.i==0] <- NA

# Read the coastline
coastline <- st_read('../data/GSHHS_shp/f/GSHHS_f_L1.shp')
## Reading layer `GSHHS_f_L1' from data source 
##   `/home2/ISAD/lah239/projects/NESE-Foraging-Strategies/data/GSHHS_shp/f/GSHHS_f_L1.shp' 
##   using driver `ESRI Shapefile'
## Simple feature collection with 179837 features and 6 fields
## Geometry type: POLYGON
## Dimension:     XY
## Bounding box:  xmin: -180 ymin: -68.92453 xmax: 180 ymax: 83.63339
## Geodetic CRS:  WGS 84
#read map as a shapefile
coastline.p <- st_transform(coastline, st_crs(t2kba.i))
rstr.ext <- st_coordinates(t2kba.i)

map_limits <- c(-5702014.0,7534.8,-585362.4,3869809.3) # Set map limits for all figures

# read the 200m isobath
iso200 <- st_read('../data/Shelf/ETOPO2024_200m_NP.shp')
## Reading layer `ETOPO2024_200m_NP' from data source 
##   `/home2/ISAD/lah239/projects/NESE-Foraging-Strategies/data/Shelf/ETOPO2024_200m_NP.shp' 
##   using driver `ESRI Shapefile'
## Simple feature collection with 3778 features and 2 fields
## Geometry type: LINESTRING
## Dimension:     XY
## Bounding box:  xmin: -180 ymin: 15 xmax: 180 ymax: 82.34583
## Geodetic CRS:  WGS 84
iso200.p <- st_transform(iso200, st_crs(t2kba.i))


# Turn colony coordinates into a sf
colony.p <- st_as_sf(colony, coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326)
colony.p <- st_transform(colony.p, st_crs(t2kba.i))

# Generate graticules
graticules <- st_graticule(lon = seq(-180,180, 10),
                           lat = seq(-90,90, 10)) 
graticules.p <- st_transform(graticules, st_crs(t2kba.i))

# Generate tick labels
ticks <- as.data.frame(cbind(graticules.p$x_start,graticules.p$y_start))
colnames(ticks) <- c("lon", "lat")
ticks <-  st_as_sf(ticks, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)
ticks.p <- st_transform(ticks, st_crs(t2kba.i))
ticks <- as.data.frame(st_coordinates(ticks.p))


x_ticks <- ticks$X[1:37]
x_labels <- c("180°","170°W","160°W","150°W","140°W","130°W","120°W","110°W","100°W",
              "90°W","80°W","70°W","60°W","50°W","40°W","30°W","20°W","10°W","0°",
              "10°E","20°E","30°E","40°E","50°E","60°E","70°E","80°E","90°E","100°E",
              "110°E","120°E","130°E","140°E","150°E","160°E","170°E","180°")

y_ticks <- ticks$Y[38:54]
y_labels <- c("80°S","70°S","60°S","50°S","40°S","30°S","20°S","10°S","0°",
              "10°N","20°N","30°N","40°N","50°N","60°N","70°N","80°N")


# Create map 
nese_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_stars(data = t2kba.i) + 
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name ='No. Ind', na.value="transparent") +
  geom_sf(data = coastline.p, fill = 'grey55' ) + 
  geom_sf(data = iso200.p, color = "grey85", size = 0.4) + 
  geom_sf(data = colony.p, aes(geometry = geometry), 
          shape = 23, color = "black", fill = "darkorange3", size = 5) +
  lims(x = c(map_limits[1], map_limits[2]), y = c(map_limits[3], map_limits[4])) + 
  labs(x = 'Longitude (°)', y = 'Latitude (°)') +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "skyblue3",
                                colour = "skyblue3"),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank()) +
         #annotation_scale(location = "bl", width_hint = 0.3) +
  
  geom_sf(data = graticules.p, colour = "grey95", alpha = 0.7, linewidth = 0.3, linetype = "dashed")
  
print(nese_plot)
